goal: P2: native-fidelity console on real backends — fidelity >= 90%, raise real coverage, no statics
must_build: Every page in ui-spec/azure/keyvaults.json (31 pages; nav: Overview, Activity log, Access control (IAM), Tags, Diagnose and solve problems, Access policies, Events, Objects, Settings, Monitoring, Automation, Help)

Backend: ARM vaults (core/azure_arm_core.py) + data planes keyvault keys/secrets (test_azure_keyvault_keys_core.py, test_azure_keyvault_secrets_core.py, test_azure_kv_crypto_core.py): vault blade, keys, secrets, versions, access policies/RBAC as config
List / create / detail / edit / delete round-trips through the native API the SDK and CLI use
always: Every page wired to the native API on /_wire (no static data); liveness fixtures for every list/detail page
core/capabilities/azure/keyvaults.json: one entry per console section with an honest level + tests; tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py must pass
Capability feature ids MUST start with 'azure.' (e.g. 'azure.keyvaults.<section>') — ids share one namespace with the AWS registry
Read the 'Cloud lenses' section of consoles/AGENT-UI.md first — use this cloud's kit, not Cloudscape
